🎃 HALLOWEEN EVENT IS LIVE! 🦇
⚔️ Hunting Together - a Ragnarok-style monster hunting RPG! ⚔️

🎁 NEW CODE: HALLOWEEN
3 EXP Potions + 3 Drop Potions! Open the Codes menu in game to claim it.

🕷️ HALLOWEEN UPDATE
• Open the Halloween Hard Worker Box and battle Pumpkin Spiders
• Collect Pumpkin Heads and spin the Halloween Gacha for spooky weapon skins for all 6 classes
• Bring Halloween Candy to the witch houses - Trick or Treat!
• New Warp Pillars to travel fast

🧪 BETA TEST - ends soon!
Reach Lv.99 for the Beta Tester title. Lv.99 on 3 classes = Limited Ice Cat. These rewards stay after the official launch!
Beta code: BETATESTER


✨ FEATURES
• 6 classes to choose from
• Hunt monsters across many zones
• Refine your weapons and armor
• Collect monster cards
• Team up and fight bosses together

🎁 More FREE CODES! Join our Discord (link in Social Links below) for codes, update news and events!

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite the game to get notified about new updates!
